findings.issue: Meaning reversed. これだけしか知りません (だけしか + negative) means 'I know ONLY this, nothing else'. The lit_en claims the opposite: that this is the only thing NOT known and everything else IS known.
findings.current: As for me, this is the only thing I don't know (apart from this, I know everything).
findings.suggested: As for me, nothing but this do I know (lit.: apart from only this, I do not know [anything]).

findings.issue: Wrong reading: 行った in 〜たことがない with destination 家に is いった (行く 'to go'), not おこなった (行う 'to carry out'). The token's own note even states the reading here is いった.
findings.current: わたしわおじいさんのいえにいちどもおこなったことがない。
findings.suggested: わたしわおじいさんのいえにいちどもいったことがない。

findings.issue: Same wrong reading mirrored in romaji: 'okonatta' should be 'itta' (行く, not 行う).
Token 行っ has reading おこなっ; in this sentence (destination に + motion + 〜たことがない) it is 行く, so the reading is いっ. The token note itself confirms いった.
Annotations shifted by one token. This だ (after 泳い) is the voiced past-tense auxiliary た of 泳いだ, not the nominalizer of ～ものだ (that is the following もの).
findings.suggested: auxiliar de tempo passado (た sonorizado em だ: 泳いだ)

findings.issue: Gloss belongs to the ものだ pattern, but this だ is the past marker of 泳いだ. The pt gloss '(elemento do padrão ～ものだ: costumava)' has the same shift and should become '(marca de passado)'.
もの is labeled as the copula, but it is the formal noun/nominalizer of ～ものだ; the copula is the following だ token. Its note 'forma neutra da cópula だ' is also misplaced (it describes the final だ).
findings.current: cópula que fecha o padrão ～ものだ

findings.issue: もの (a noun) is glossed as a copula ('it is'). The pt gloss 'é (era assim)' has the same swap and should become e.g. 'coisa (nominalizador de ～ものだ: costumava)'.

Self-contradiction: the explanation defines the quoted clause as テニスの試合に勝つ, then says 私は is 'dentro da citação'. 私は is the matrix topic, outside the quote. expl_en's 'Within: 私は topic' has the same slip.
findings.current: Dentro da citação, 私は é o tópico
findings.suggested: Na frase como um todo, 私は é o tópico (fora da citação)
